acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Celestials family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Messenger, T1, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Ribbon-Line Decree Initiate (Initiate) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two normal construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: A small, slight, symmetrical humanoid in plain white robes with bare feet, two soft feathered wings, a simple ring of family-native light, and one long script ribbon.

Signature mechanic: Single Word: the Messenger unrolls one ivory ribbon from the simple ring halo to a chosen point; sacred script advances once along it, and the slight two-wing figure descends in a straight line to deliver a palm strike before returning upward.
battlefieldDuty: Probe positional reading by delivering one straight ribbon decree between its simple halo and a marked floor point, then descending along that line with bare feet exposed.
constructionDimensions: Family-native, non-affinity materials remain white feather, ivory silk, polished gold, white marble, sacred script, restrained sunlight-colored radiance, source-native pure light, and exact halo geometry with visible physical or symbolic joints.

Motion and effects remain ordered rather than elemental: wings beat in counted pairs, script advances along ring tracks, ribbons mark straight decrees, light stays bounded to body and halo surfaces, and no unexplained wake trails through the environment.
counterplay: Step off the exact ribbon line and strike its floor seal or the dim ring joint while the Messenger's bare feet and folded wings are committed to descent. Affinity signal: A ribbon seal, shield grip, wing root, halo bearing, mask seam, or orrery axle preserves the established weak point while source-native light dims to show recovery.
forbiddenTreatments: Treating family-native light, radiance, sunlight color, or halo emission alone as Fire, Wind, or any elemental affinity
identityInvariants: An idealized upright humanoid silhouette remains deliberately symmetrical, with feathered wings and a halo above or behind the head even as the body becomes increasingly abstract.
White, ivory, pale gold, sunlight yellow, and sky blue remain family-native ordered radiance rather than elemental affinity colors.
Polished gold, white marble, feather, silk, and source-native pure light stay layered so armor, cloth, wing roots, halo joints, and the suggested body remain readable.
Halos, ring geometry, sacred script, ribbons, censers, blank ceremonial masks, and wing count communicate rank through exact symmetry and moving parts rather than glow or size alone.
Escalation increases wing pairs and halo complexity from a simple ring to an orrery, but each tier preserves a breakable alignment joint and a learnable ordered command.
telegraph: Both soft wings fold evenly, the plain robe hangs still, and one readable script line travels from the simple halo down the taut ribbon.
